name: Open dedicated Products page and browse all products
description: Verifies the separate Products page can be opened and used to find products.
steps: Open the Products link in the navigation
Change the category or sort order
expected: The dedicated Products view displays the catalogue and updates the results based on search, category and sort.

name: Add a product from the Products page to the shared bag
description: Verifies a product selected on the dedicated page appears in the same shopping bag.
steps: Open Products on a mobile viewport
Add an item using its plus button
expected: The bag count increases and the selected item is listed in the shared cart.

name: Return to homepage from Products page
description: Verifies shoppers can navigate between the dedicated product catalogue and the homepage.
expected: The homepage sections appear and the Products view is no longer shown.

name: Validate checkout remains demo-only
description: Verifies the Products page uses the existing shared cart and checkout safety disclosures.
steps: Open the bag and continue to checkout
expected: Checkout shows validation and clearly states that no payment is collected.
